english.title: Conspiracy to improperly perform a relevant function/activity in anticipation of financial or other advantage
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to improperly perform a relevant function or activity, or for another to improperly perform a relevant function or activity and to request, assent to or acquiesce to that improper performance, in anticipation of or in consequence of requesting, agreeing to receive or accepting a financial or other advantage
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(1) and (5) and 11 of the Bribery Act 2010 and section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Director of the Serious Fraud Office, section 10.

other.penalty:
Indictment only: ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
